description: Na₂Ti₂O₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.82 Å. Ti is bonded to five O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing TiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-2.05 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Ti atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na and three equivalent Ti atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaTi₃ tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Na and two equivalent Ti atoms.
